description: Controlled matched evaluation of selective recovery policies (Cheap Filter, Eviction-Only, Terminal-Only, and Combined) against Resumption Baseline and Terminal-Reserve Control.
prior_data_exposure: Development/validation partition (random-64-64-10, warehouse-10-20-10-2-2). Untouched test partition remains strictly unexposed.
accounting: 2 maps * 2 scenarios * 2 agent scales * 2 budgets * 2 seeds = 32 matched cells * 6 variants = 192 total runs
reserve_selection: ceil(2 * maximum of 60 measured 100-agent, 8-candidate recovery calls in milliseconds); heuristic for at most two FIFO checkpoints; not a worst-case guarantee
analysis: Primary descriptive comparison: resumption deadline SoC minus restart-only deadline SoC; negative favors resumption. Same 32 exposed cells; single predeclared comparison.
execution: Sequential stored cyclic order; 32 cells cannot balance six first-position rotations exactly. No selective reruns.
